messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — CloudForge and Redwood want to run a joint 3-part webinar series + marketplace announcement. Thinking: intro (what problem), deep-dive demo (technical), customer panel (use case). Need to lock landing page, speaker lineup, and inbound lead routing. Thoughts?
Anjali (Marketing): Love it. We should pair the webinars with a short benchmark narrative — simple numbers on latency + cost vs the common baseline. That will help the blog after.
Liam (Product Demo): I can own the demo + slides. Need partner env access and a 5-7 minute scripted demo path. Also want a fallback recording if live API flaps.
Omar (CloudForge - Partner): CloudForge is +1. Tentative dates: Apr 26 (intro) and May 10 (deep dive). Will confirm speakers by EOD Thursday.
Priya (Growth): Important: registration -> SFDC mapping. We want clean utm tagging and campaign mapping to create a partner-sourced lead flow. @Anjali can you confirm utm schema?
Anjali (Marketing): Proposed UTM: utm_source=cloudforge&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=cloudforge_redwood_q2
Maya (Marketing): +1. Example registration URL: https://redwo.in/webinar?utm_source=cloudforge&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=cloudforge_redwood_q2
DevEx Bot: FYI — check that the embed-demo org has the latest API key and rate limits set to demo tier before the run.
Liam (Product Demo): Can we get a short demo script (5 bullets) in the next week? Also need a callout for fallback if live model is slow (pre-recorded clip + slides).
Anjali (Marketing): For the benchmark narrative I'll pull 3 datapoints: 95th perc latency, cost per 1k tokens, and throughput for a standard conversation template. Need model names + serving config from eng-ml.
Maya (Marketing): Action list (draft):
- Liam: demo + slides + pre-record fallback (due Apr 5)
- Anjali: benchmark writeup + UTM + landing microcopy (due Apr 8)
- Priya: SFDC campaign + inbound routing rules + SDR handoff (due Apr 12)
- Omar: confirm partner speakers + customer for panel (due Apr 3)
- Maya: landing page + nurture email flow + blog outline (due Apr 10)
Omar (CloudForge - Partner): On leads — CloudForge prefers initial routing to their SDR queue for 48h then handover to Redwood if not contacted. Is that doable?
Priya (Growth): Yes. Routing plan idea: partner_leads -> partner_sdr_queue -> if no touch in 48h -> webhook to /webhooks/partner-handoff with SFDC campaign mapping. We'll need partner to accept the webhook or provide SFTP.
Maya (Marketing): We'll put the routing steps into the Notion playbook and add the exact endpoint. Also need agreement on who closes the MQL -> SAL definition.
Anjali (Marketing): For post-webinar content: short clip + benchmark blog + gated whitepaper. We'll use the webinar recording to seed the blog and the whitepaper as the gated download.
Liam (Product Demo): I'll build a small sandbox and share credentials with Omar by Apr 1.
Omar (CloudForge - Partner): We'll line up one customer for the panel; will confirm name by Monday.
Priya (Growth): Also recommend a joint email cadence: 3 emails (reminder 1 week, reminder 1 day, replay). Add a short nurture track for attendees to the benchmark whitepaper.
Maya (Marketing): Rehearsal week of Apr 15 (technical + run-through). I'll send calendar invites after dates are locked.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal placeholder created: Apr 16 10:00 PDT — invite will follow.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks — I'll spin this into Asana and Notion and post links here. If anyone wants to be added to the content review loop, ping me.
Priya (Growth): Quick note on tracking: please include these fields in the registration form: ref_partner (cloudforge), partner_acct_id, utm_campaign. Keeps SFDC joins clean.
Anjali (Marketing): I'll add that to the landing form. Also we'll A/B the hero CTA copy: 'Request demo' vs 'See a live run' to measure conversion.
Maya (Marketing): Great — moving to action.
